purpose: Every training target uses the same complete production-compatible structural envelope. Structural tokens are supervised; strong/weak semantic values are supervised per eligibility; unavailable semantic value tokens are masked (-100). No fabricated supervised labels.

structural_token_supervision.note: Structural and field-name tokens retain causal-LM token IDs in the loss.

weak_semantic_supervision.note: Causal-LM token IDs use weight 1.0; weakness is recorded in metadata only (not down-weighted at the token-ID layer for this envelope).

ambiguity_present.notes: Boolean never known: put false in envelope but MASK the value token; do not supervise false as a negative.

ambiguity_types.notes: Empty list is structural placeholder; brackets may be structural; value tokens masked when unavailable.

candidate_interpretations.notes: Deterministic candidate order when supervised; empty list when unavailable.

capability_status.notes: Schema allows null or unknown. Use null as masked unavailable filler to avoid asserting unknown as a supervised label. If unknown is ever placed in the envelope without eligibility, MASK it.

clarification_question.notes: Nullable string: null in envelope, MASK null token when unavailable.

clarification_subtype.notes: Nullable string: null in envelope, MASK null token when unavailable.

clarification_targets.notes: Empty list structural placeholder when unavailable.

compound_ambiguity.notes: Boolean never known: false in envelope, MASK value token.

compound_ambiguity_count.notes: Schema-compatible zero filler; MASK value token when unavailable.

context_sampling_uncertainty.notes: Never in training policy; always masked_unavailable_envelope.

cpc.notes: Unavailable CPC: full 13-slot object with status=unknown and value=null. MASK semantic values; SUPERVISE structure and field names. Slots always complete in CPC_SLOT_NAMES order at build time; canonical JSON uses sort_keys for nested objects.

intent_summary.notes: Nullable string: null in envelope, MASK null token when unavailable. Alias: intent.

primary_ambiguity_type.notes: Nullable string/enum: null in envelope, MASK when unavailable.

recommended_strategy.notes: Schema-valid route filler when unavailable (execute with empty strategy_sequence). MASK value token. If supervised as clarify/silently_resolve/face_preserving_rejection/multi_step without required companion fields, envelope build must reject the record.

rejection_reason.notes: Nullable string: null in envelope, MASK when unavailable.

resolution_evidence.notes: Never in training policy; always masked. Empty list structural placeholder.

resolution_method.notes: Never in training policy; always masked_unavailable_envelope.

resolved_slots.notes: Never in training policy; always masked. Empty list structural placeholder.

risk_level.notes: Schema allows null or unknown. Use null as masked unavailable filler to avoid asserting unknown as supervised. If unknown is used without eligibility, MASK it.

risk_relevant.notes: Boolean never known: false in envelope, MASK value token.

selected_interpretation.notes: Nullable object/string: null in envelope, MASK when unavailable.

speech_act.notes: Nullable enum: null in envelope, MASK when unavailable.

strategy_sequence.notes: Empty list when unavailable or when recommended_strategy is not multi_step.

supporting_evidence.notes: Never in training policy; always masked. Empty list structural placeholder.

unresolved_slots.notes: Never in training policy; always masked. Empty list structural placeholder.

weak_when_weakly_eligible_note: Fields whose field_group is weakly_eligible use treatment weak_when_weakly_eligible at runtime: value tokens retain IDs; metadata records weak=true.

minimum_useful_supervision.note: Materially above prior job-6059 partial-target density (~6.79%) without fabricating labels.
